label: Phased build of an approval-gated session-capture dev tool
description: Builds a multi-phase developer tool from a design spec: capture hooks, SQLite store, redaction, review CLI, detection/clustering/generation modules, registry install, MCP tool stubs, install scripts, and tests, with user approval gating each phase.
type_rationale: Long, judgment-heavy engineering work driven by a spec and per-phase approvals. A skill can hold the phase workflow and call scripts for the deterministic parts such as test runs and installs.
